verses.sanskrit: याज्ञवक्ल्य उवाच । सांख्यज्ञानं मया प्रोक्तं योगज्ञानं निबोध मे। यथाश्रुतं यथादृष्टं तत्त्वेन नृपसत्तम॥१॥
verses.english: Yajnavalkya said, I have already spoken to you of the science of the Sankhyas. Hear now as I truly describe the science of the Yogins as heard and seen my me, O best of kings. are

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति सांख्यसमं ज्ञानं नास्ति योगसमं बलम्। तावुभावेकचर्यौ तावुभावनिधनौ स्मृतौ॥२॥
verses.english: There is no Knowledge like that of the Sankhyas. There is no power like that of Yoga. These two prescribe the same practices, and both are considered as capable of leading to Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: पृथक् पृथक् प्रपश्यन्ति येऽप्यबुद्धिरता नराः। वयं तु राजन् पश्याम एकमेव तु निश्चयात्॥३॥
verses.english: Those men who not blest with intelligence consider the Sankhya and the Yoga systems to be different from each other. We, however, O king, regard them as one and the same, according to the conclusion to which we have arrived.

verses.sanskrit: यदेव योगाः पश्यन्ति तत्सांख्यैरपि दृश्यते। एकं सांख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स तत्त्ववित्॥४॥
verses.english: What the Yogins have in view is the very same which the Sankhyas also have in view. He who sees both the Sankhya and the Yoga systems to be one and the same is to be considered as truly conversant with the principles that ordain the universe.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रप्रधानानपरान्विद्धि योगानरिन्दम्। तेनैव चाथ देहेन विचरन्ति दिशो दश॥५॥
verses.english: Know, O king, that the vital airs and the senses are the chief instruments for practising Yoga. By only regulating those vital airs and the senses, Yogins go everywhere at their will.

verses.sanskrit: यावद्धि प्रलयस्तात सूक्ष्मेणाष्टगुणेन ह। योगेन लोकान्विचरन्सुखं संन्यस्य चानघ॥६॥
verses.english: When the gross body is destroyed, Yogins, gifted with subtile bodies possessed of the eight Yoga powers wander over the universe, enjoying all sorts of happiness, O sinless one.

verses.sanskrit: वेदेषु चाष्टगुणिनं योगमाहुर्मनीषिणः। सूक्ष्ममष्टगुणं प्राहुर्नेतरं नृपसत्तम॥७॥
verses.english: The wise have, in the scriptures, spoken of Yoga as giving eight sorts of power. They have spoken of Yoga as gifted with eight limbs.

verses.sanskrit: द्विगुणं योगकृत्यं तु योगानां प्राहुरुत्तमम्। सगुणं निर्गुणं चैव यथा शास्त्रनिदर्शनम्॥८॥
verses.english: Indeed, O king, they have not spoken of any other sort of Yoga. It has been said that the practices of Yogins, excellent as those are of two sorts. Those two sorts, according to the characteristics described in the scriptures, are practices endued with attributes and those freed from attributes.

verses.sanskrit: धारणं चैव मनसः प्राणायामश्च पार्थिव। एकाग्रता च मनसः प्राणायामस्तथैव च॥९॥
verses.english: The concentration of the mind together with the regulation of the vital airs. O king, is one sort. The concentration of the mind along with subjugation of the senses, is of another sort. The first kind of Yoga is said to be that possessed of qualities; the second kind is said to be that freed from qualities.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणायामो हि सगुणो निर्गुणं धारयेन्मनः। यद्यदृश्यति मुञ्चन्वै प्राणान्मैथिलसत्तम। वाताधिक्यं भवत्येव तस्मात्तं न समाचरेत्॥१०॥
verses.english: The, again, Regulation of the Vital air is Yoga with qualities. In Yoga without qualities, the mind, freed from its functions, should be fixed. Only the regulation of the vital air which is said to be endued with qualities should, in the first instance, be practised, for, O king of Mithila, if the vital air be exhaled without mentally thinking upon a definite image, the wind in the neophyte's system will increase to his great injury.

verses.sanskrit: निशायाः प्रथमे यामे चोदना द्वादश स्मृताः। मध्ये स्वप्नात्परे यामे द्वादशैव तु चोदनाः॥११॥
verses.english: In the first period of the night, twelve ways of suppressing the vital air are recommended. After sleep, in the last period of the night, other twelve ways of doing the same have been laid down.

verses.sanskrit: तदेवमुपशान्तेन दान्तेनैकान्तशीलिना। आत्मारामेण बुद्धेन योक्तव्योऽऽत्मा न संशयः॥१२॥
verses.english: Forsooth, one endued with tranquillity, of controlled senses, living in retirement, rejoicing in one's in one's own self, and fully conversant with the meaning of the scriptures, should fix his Soul.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चानामिन्द्रियाणां तु दोषानाक्षिप्य पञ्चधा। शब्दं रूपं तथा स्पर्शं रसं गन्धं तथैव च॥१३॥
verses.english: Removing the five faults of the five sense, viz., (withdrawing them from their objects of) sound, form, touch, taste, and scent, and removing those conditions called Pratibha and Apavanga, O king, of the Mithilas, all the senses should be fixed upon the mind.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिभामपवर्गं च प्रतिसंहृत्य मैथिल। इन्द्रियग्राममखिलं मनस्यभिनिवेश्य ह॥१४॥
मनस्तथैवाहंकारे प्रतिष्ठाप्य नराधिप। अहंकार तथा बुद्धौ बुद्धिं च प्रकृतावपि॥१५॥
एवं हि परिसंख्याय ततो ध्यायन्ति केवलम्। विरजस्कमलं नित्यमनन्तं शुद्धमव्रणम्॥१६॥
तस्थुषं पुरुषं नित्यमभेद्यमजरामरम्। शाश्वतं चाव्ययं चैव ईशानं ब्रह्म चाव्ययम्॥१७॥
युक्तस्य तु महाराज लक्षणान्युपधारय। लक्षणं तु प्रसादस्य यथा तृप्तः सुखं स्वपेत्॥१८॥
निर्वाते तु यथा दीपो ज्वलेत्स्नेहसमन्वितः। निश्चलोऽर्ध्वशिखस्तद्वद्युक्तमाहुर्मनीषिणः॥१९॥
पाषाण इव मेघोत्थैर्यथा बिन्दुभिराहतः। नालं चालयितुं शक्यस्तथा युक्तस्य लक्षणम्॥२०॥
शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषैर्विविधैर्गीतवादितैः। क्रियमाणैर्न कम्पेत मुक्तस्यैतन्निदर्शनम्॥२१॥
तैलपात्रं यथा पूर्णं कराभ्यां गृह्य पूरुषः। सोपानमारुहेद्भीतस्तर्ज्यमानोऽसिपाणिभिः॥२२॥
संयतात्मा भयात्तेषां न पात्राद्बिन्दुमुत्सृजेत्। तथैवोत्तरमागम्य एकाग्रमनसस्तथा॥२३॥
स्थिरत्वादिन्द्रियाणां तु निश्चलत्वात्तथैव च। एवं युक्तस्य तु मुनेर्लक्षणान्युपलक्षयेत्॥२४॥
स्वयुक्तः पश्यते ब्रह्म यत्तत्परममव्ययम्। महतस्तमसो मध्ये स्थितं ज्वलनसन्निभम्॥२५॥
एतेन केवलं याति त्यक्त्वा देहमसाक्षिकम्। कालेन महता राजन्श्रुतिरेषा सनातनी॥२६॥
एतद्धि योगं योगानां किमन्यद्योगलक्षणम्। विज्ञाय तद्धि मन्यन्ते कृतकृत्या मनीषिणः॥२७॥
